fact: The National Treasury's 2024 Education Sector Report gives the coverage of primary schools' data by NEMIS as 89 per cent achieved in FY 2023/24 against a target of 85, with targets of 90 per cent for 2024/25 and 100 per cent for 2025/26 in its 2025/26-2027/28 medium-term plan, and states that the Ministry transitioned NEMIS to KEMIS in FY 2023/24; no counts are given, and the figure is schools whose data NEMIS covers, not schools entering attendance or results.
title: Education Sector, Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2025/26 - 2027/28: 2024 Education Sector Report
publisher: Republic of Kenya, The National Treasury
